question: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.
sql:
WITH first_payment AS (
  SELECT 
    p.customer_id,
    MIN(p.payment_date) AS first_payment_date
  FROM payment p
  GROUP BY p.customer_id
),
first_rental AS (
  SELECT 
    fp.customer_id,
    p.rental_id
  FROM first_payment fp
  JOIN payment p ON fp.customer_id = p.customer_id AND fp.first_payment_date = p.payment_date
),
first_rental_film AS (
  SELECT 
    fr.customer_id,
    f.rating
  FROM first_rental fr
  JOIN rental r ON fr.rental_id = r.rental_id
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
),
customer_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    r.customer_id,
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.rental_id) AS total_rentals
  FROM rental r
  JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
  GROUP BY r.customer_id
)
SELECT 
  frf.rating,
  AVG(ct.total_amount) AS avg_total_amount,
  AVG(ct.total_rentals - 1) AS avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_rental_film frf
JOIN customer_totals ct ON frf.customer_id = ct.customer_id
GROUP BY frf.rating
ORDER BY frf.rating
